Name: Nunudodo's Kent for Seasonal Cute
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
[size=4]IMO there's not really enough options for Kent portraits out there. [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/46896]Bara Kent Nunudodo's Portrait[/url] was published a few days ago and I was given permission to make it compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5450]Seasonal Outfits - Slightly Cuter Aesthetics[/url], so here it is![/size]

[size=4]*NOTE: He is NOT super muscle-y in this one since he isn't in seasonal cute. If someone else wants to tackle that go ahead, I'm not confident enough in my skills to try lol[/size]

[size=4]All assets used were either open permission or I was granted permission to use. Assets used provided by:
Nunudodo[/size]
[size=4]Katsudon77 [/size]
[size=4]Ailin
Tanpoponoko
PKpixel[/size]
[size=4]Poltergeister[/size]

[size=4]To use, download and overwrite your Seasonal Cute assets with the included ones.[/size]

[size=4]Enjoy![/size]
